Sweet Mochi Peanut Dumplings
By: J
Published: Monday, April 25, 2011 - 3:10pm

Ingredients




1 pound glutinous rice flour (mochi flour)
1 1/2 cups dry roasted unsalted peanuts
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup kinako

Preparation

1 Combine the flour with 2 cups of water and mix until a sticky dough forms – the dough should be wet enough to bind together, but dry enough to hold its shape like play dough. Adjust the dough by sprinkling a little water on it or adding more flour until the desired consistency is reached. Roll the dough into small bite-sized balls about the size of a teaspoon and place the balls on a plate. 2 Combine the peanuts, sugar and kinako in a food processor and pulse until all the peanuts are crushed. Transfer the mixture to a shallow bowl. 3 Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Boil the dough in small batches of about 12 dumplings. The dumplings are done when they start to float. 4 Remove the dumplings with a strainer and immediately roll them in the peanut mixture. Remove to a plate and serve while warm.
